\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows,positioning}

\begin{document}
% This is the declaration used by the installed bondgraph.sty package. Keeping
% it after library loading also makes the dependency order explicit.
\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclarecombine[\pgflinewidth]
  {combined}{combined}{left to}{left to}{|}{|}
\makeatother

\begin{tikzpicture}[
  element/.style={draw,circle,minimum size=9mm,font=\small},
  junction/.style={draw,rectangle,minimum size=8mm,font=\small},
  node distance=16mm and 24mm
]
  \node[element,fill=blue!8] (source) {$S_e$};
  \node[junction,right=of source] (j0) {$0$};
  \node[element,fill=orange!10,right=of j0] (resistor) {$R$};
  \node[element,fill=green!10,below=of j0] (capacitor) {$C$};

  \draw[very thick,-combined] (source) -- node[above] {$e_1$} (j0);
  \draw[very thick,-combined] (j0) -- node[above] {$f_2$} (resistor);
  \draw[very thick,-combined] (j0) -- node[right] {$e_3$} (capacitor);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
